hooks.name: Modem change: run property tests and SNR report
hooks.description: When modem, protocol or channel code changes, run the full Vitest suite (including the fast-check properties and the SNR sweep) and update the success-rate table in README.md from the printed report. Never edit the numbers by hand.

action.prompt: A modem, protocol or channel file changed. Run `npx vitest run`. If any test fails, stop and report the failing property and its counterexample. If all pass, copy the SNR sweep table printed by test/noise.test.ts into the 'Measured on the simulated channel' table in README.md, replacing the old rows, and note the date. Do not change any number that the test did not print.
